This maize plot is big for my household, so I will depend mostly on family work and keep costs low. Here in Lindi, fertilizer is expensive, and on an intercropped field I usually plant the seed I trust rather than buying many inputs. I can add some manure where I have it, but I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use chemicals unless there is a serious problem. For this size of plot, I will also need to hire some labor for peak work like planting and weeding.
